thread:
maria: Quick question— should the vectors preview show both "Export all vectors" and "Download selected vectors" by default, or hide the second until a selection exists? Trying to balance discoverability + clutter.

jonathan: Show both but disabled when none selected. Users learn the feature exists and we avoid layout shifts. Tooltip: 'Select rows to enable'.

sam: Agreed. Small accessibility note: don't reorder DOM to swap primary. Toggle visual emphasis via classes and update an SR-only status region with `role=status`.

aleyna: For SR copy: when selection changes announce "n rows selected. Download selected vectors enabled." Also ensure buttons use `aria-disabled=\"true\"` when inactive.

leo: On keyboard flow, tabbing should reach the toolbar after row actions. If toolbar is sticky, don't steal focus on scroll. Also confirm mobile collapse keeps selection state when menu is opened.

design-bot: Design snapshot uploaded: https://redwood.design/links/vec-cta-compact.

maria: Great. Action items: Sam updates mock to show disabled state + tooltip; Aleyna drafts SR strings; Leo does quick NVDA pass on staging; Jonathan adds CSV headers (`vector_id`, `source_id`, `rerank_score`) to export spec. I'll merge notes into the PR. :white_check_mark:

sam: One last tiny copy tweak: use 'Export all vectors (CSV/JSONL)' to make formats explicit.

maria: Done. Closing thread after Leo's smoke test.
